decisions.reason: Paper dates and extracted inspirations do not certify checkpoint exclusion or unassisted reconstruction.
Data/goal assistance, target chronology, verifiers, and source-data rights need item-level review.
DOI-linked dates and an output auditor do not certify checkpoint history; matching a later method is not alone contamination.
Hindsight bibliography assistance, parametric exposure, judge validity, and release terms remain.

methodological_judgments: Independent correct rediscovery is a positive outcome, not an output-contamination test failure.
Actual immutable checkpoint release including post-training must precede earliest contribution-bearing disclosure for historical admission.
A prompt-time temporal cutoff does not certify a model's weights or a retrieved document version.
Hindsight-selected bibliographies and precursor pairs are assistance even if each input predates the target.
No-match named-entity audit pass does not prove absence of paraphrased memorization.
Date strata compare different item sets and cannot alone identify a causal memorization effect.
